description: Type the number from the order form. 0 is Home Delivery.
label: Pick-Up Location
name: Sales Order-custom_pick_up_location

description: Set on the processing line added automatically under a beef/hog share.
label: Processing for share
name: Sales Invoice Item-custom_share_item

description: The client's own customer number. Left blank it is filled on save with the number after the highest one on file. Type one in to keep a legacy number or to correct it.
label: Customer ID
name: Customer-custom_customer_id

description: Block submitting a claim that has a row of this type with no receipt attached. Ticked by default; untick it for mileage, where there is nothing to photograph.
label: Receipt Required
name: Expense Claim Type-custom_receipt_required

description: Show Miles / Rate per Mile on claim rows of this type and compute the amount as Miles x Rate per Mile.
label: Is Mileage Reimbursement
name: Expense Claim Type-custom_is_mileage

description: Miles driven, units bought, nights stayed - whatever the rate is charged per. Amount = Qty x Rate.
label: Qty
name: Expense Claim Detail-custom_qty

description: E.g. the IRS standard mileage rate for the year.
label: Default Rate per Mile
name: Expense Claim Type-custom_default_rate_per_mile

description: Price per unit from the receipt. For mileage this defaults to the rate on the Expense Claim Type. Leave blank to type the Amount directly.
label: Rate
name: Expense Claim Detail-custom_rate

description: When the employee asked to be reimbursed. Independent of the expense date on each row and of the Posting Date that drives the GL.
label: Request Date
name: Expense Claim-custom_request_date

description: Required for every expense type except mileage (controlled by Receipt Required on the Expense Claim Type).
label: Receipt
name: Expense Claim Detail-custom_receipt

description: The claim type(s) on this request, kept in step with the Expenses table so the list can be read at a glance.
label: Expense Claim Type
name: Expense Claim-custom_expense_type_summary

description: The person approving this claim — they select themselves. Any enabled user can be picked; nothing has to be pre-set on the Employee or the Department. To actually click Approve they need the Expense Approver or HR Manager role.
label: Approver
name: Expense Claim-custom_approver

description: Full name of the approver, for the list and for print.
label: Approver Name
name: Expense Claim-custom_approver_name

description: Requested -> Approved -> Paid. Derived from the standard approval status and the amount actually reimbursed.
label: Reimbursement Status
name: Expense Claim-custom_reimbursement_status
options:
Draft
Requested
Approved
Rejected
Paid
Cancelled

description: Stamped with today's date the first time this claim is marked Approved. Editable — back-date it if the approval actually happened earlier.
label: Approval Date
name: Expense Claim-custom_approval_date

description: Set on the row ls_foods maintains for the Purchased Items table. Do not edit that row by hand — it is rebuilt on every save.
label: Auto Generated
name: Expense Claim Detail-custom_auto_generated

description: Filled by the website landing page handler. This is the TCPA consent record for any SMS sent to this lead — it is written once, by the website, and is read-only here on purpose.
label: Website Form & SMS Consent
name: Lead-custom_website_consent_section

description: Set from the Salary Slip (or Payment Entry) that reimbursed it.
label: Paid Date
name: Expense Claim-custom_paid_date

description: What the visitor agreed to, in the words that were on screen.
label: Consent Given
name: Lead-custom_consent_given

description: When they agreed, exactly as the website recorded it. Data, not Datetime, so the captured string is preserved verbatim.
label: Consent Timestamp
name: Lead-custom_consent_timestamp

description: Unticking this disables the address, so pickers stop offering it.
label: Current
name: Address-custom_current

description: IP address the submission came from.
label: Consent IP
name: Lead-custom_consent_ip

description: Version of the SMS disclosure wording that was shown, e.g. flyer-v1. Bumped by the website whenever that wording changes.
label: Consent Version
name: Lead-custom_consent_version

description: Things the employee bought out of pocket. Items that maintain stock are received into the warehouse by a Stock Entry when this claim is submitted; everything else is charged straight to the account on the row.
label: Stock / Supplies Purchased by Employee
name: Expense Claim-custom_stock_reimbursement_section

description: The rest of the submitted form, as posted by the website.
label: Form Details
name: Lead-custom_form_details

description: Pounds in one case on this order. Defaults to the item's nominal weight — type over it with the expected or weighed figure. Drives Line Weight and Total Weight (lb); on an item with a Per Pound price, Rate = Unit Price x Case Weight.
label: Case Weight (lb)
name: Sales Order Item-custom_case_weight

description: Actual pounds in one case for this shipment. Defaults to the item's nominal weight — type over it with the weighed figure. Drives Unit Price, Line Weight and the invoice's Total Weight (lb). It never changes the price.
label: Case Weight (lb)
name: Sales Invoice Item-custom_case_weight

description: Mirrored into the Expenses table as a single auto-maintained row so the claim total, the GL entry and the amount payable to the employee all include these purchases.
label: Total Purchased Items
name: Expense Claim-custom_total_stock_amount

description: What one pound works out to on this line — the item's Per Pound price, or Rate divided by Case Weight. Blank on a beef/hog share: the order charges its fixed deposit, not a price per lb.
label: Unit Price
name: Sales Order Item-custom_unit_price

description: What one pound works out to on this line — Rate divided by Case Weight. On beef/hog shares it is the item's price per lb, and Rate = Unit Price x Case Weight.
label: Unit Price
name: Sales Invoice Item-custom_unit_price

description: Material Receipt posted on submit for the stock items above.
label: Stock Entry
name: Expense Claim-custom_stock_entry

description: A quarter/half/whole beef or hog. The order charges its Standard Selling price (the fixed deposit); the invoice charges hanging weight x its Per Pound price, adds the processing line and deducts the deposit.
label: Beef / hog share
name: Item-custom_priced_per_lb

description: Fee line added under this share on the final invoice: hanging weight x the fee's price per lb (e.g. Processing Fee).
label: Processing item
name: Item-custom_processing_item

description: Lets this invoice be submitted with unpriced rows — samples, replacements, goodwill. Leave unticked and ls_foods blocks a submit where any row has a quantity but no rate.
label: Allow Zero Rate
name: Sales Invoice-custom_allow_zero_rate

description: Each row is a real Address document. Untick Current to retire one — the Address is disabled, never deleted, so documents that already print it stay intact.
label: Addresses
name: Customer-custom_addresses

description: Kept in step with the Phone Nos table of the customer's contact.
label: Phone Numbers
name: Customer-custom_phone_numbers

description: Kept in step with the Email IDs table of the customer's contact.
label: Email Addresses
name: Customer-custom_email_addresses

description: Total hours worked this pay period. Enter each week.
label: Hours Worked
name: Salary Slip-custom_hours_worked

description: Auto-filled by the ls_foods before_validate hook from prior submitted slips this calendar year. Do not edit.
label: YTD Gross Pay (prior periods)
name: Salary Slip-custom_ytd_gross_pay

description: Auto-filled by the ls_foods validate hook: month-to-date gross pay grouped by posting date (prior submitted slips this month + this slip). Do not edit.
label: MTD Gross Pay (this month)
name: Salary Slip-custom_mtd_gross_pay

description: The share lines (fixed deposit per quarter/half/whole). Compare with Advance Paid below.
label: Deposit Due
name: Sales Order-custom_deposit_due

description: Hourly pay rate. Hourly Wage = Hours Worked x Rate per Hour.
label: Rate per Hour
name: Employee-custom_rate_per_hour

description: Date the employee was actually paid. Set from the Make Payment Entry dialog; it is the posting date of the payment Journal Entry.
label: Payment Date
name: Salary Slip-custom_payment_date

description: The payout entry (Dr Payroll Payable / Cr Bank). Separate from the accrual entry in the Journal Entry field above.
label: Payment Journal Entry
name: Salary Slip-custom_payment_journal_entry

description: Approved, unpaid expense claims for this employee. Use Get Approved Reimbursements to pull them in. These are added to the net pay but NOT to gross pay — a reimbursement is not wages, so it must not be taxed.
label: Expense Reimbursements
name: Salary Slip-custom_reimbursements

description: Added to Net Pay after deductions.
label: Total Reimbursement
name: Salary Slip-custom_total_reimbursement
